reviews.comment: Lectures are detailed and engaging.  Exams are straight from lectures, so attending class and taking good notes is very important.  1 cheat sheet allowed on exams, and questions aren't hard.  Some written reflections (easy) and a couple essays which are actually pretty fun if you start early and give yourself time.

She is absolutely hilarious, and her lectures are very fun to attend. Her class is mostly based on exams, but they are open note! I struggled a little at first, but she is very kind and helpful during office hours. There is a lot of extra credit, so I would do it!

Prof Ellison was a great professor. Good, passionate lectures, however, you absolutely need to go to class. Her notes are fill in the blank, so don't skip! Tests are easy if you put any effort into going to class. She also cracks some jokes now and then that make the subject matter more bareable.

Professor Ellisen is one of the nicest professors I've ever met! She tells history like it's a story and I thoroughly enjoyed her lectures. Course is pretty exam-heavy. Her exams are not difficult as long as you paid attention in lecture and took notes. You will need to go to class though.

She is very passionate about history and teaching. Her lectures are fun and easy to understand. She makes class engaging. Her attendance was extra credit. Super accessible and willing to work with you.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You can tell Professor Ellisen loves history and loves her students. If you show up to lectures you will pass, its pretty much that simple. Extra credit opportunites and homework are easy and help pad your grade against exams.

Love her! She was always came to lecture with great energy. She offers a short extra credit assignment that can bump your total grade up 2%. Attendance isn't mandatory, but if perfect adds 1% to your total grade. 4 exams, non-cumulative, & all pretty straight forward. 1 page front/back cheat sheet allowed. Scored a 94, 94, 80, & 88.

The tests are open note but they're long and hard. She lectures fast, fill in the blank, test reviews don't help, and reads directly from her slides. Don't take this class if you take your time with exams because you have to spend 1 minute for each question or you will run out of time.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor overall, attendance isn't mandatory but extra credit is given if you are present all classes. I would say it is a little lecture heavy but she manages to keep them very interesting. There are 4 exams and one essay with one extra credit opportunity. Overall I would highly recommend taking her class!

Took this class because everything was online. Yeah, that's not true anymore. Absolutely dislike history with a passion, so the 1:15-minute lectures were brutal for me. Only took it for my credit. Lowest grade in college yet, but I will say, Coulda applied myself more. Amazing lady, although it's what I get for trying to take the easy way out.

Professor Ellisen is an amazing teacher. I just took this class since it's required, but she made the class easy and enjoyable. The class is test heavy with one essay, and one extra credit opportunity. The test are take-home, open note, and online. You don't have to go to the lectures, but I highly recommend doing so, she makes the class fun/easy.

Dr. Ellisen was a great lecturer, I would definitely take her again! Lectures cover a lot of information but she kept them interesting! The class is pretty test-heavy with only one essay to boost a grade though. The tests are open-note, so they weren't too bad. I barely squeezed out an A with the extra credit assignment, but overall I'd recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever had. Class is super easy, graded on 4 exams (all online and open note) and 1 essay. If you usually do well by getting good grades on busy work, this may not be the best class for you. Ellisen's humor, passion, and care for students made this class extremely interesting and memorable.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was just wonderful. Her lectures were so informative and entertaining, the extra credit was fun and so was the one essay we were assigned. I learned so much from her and you can really tell she cares about her students. My favorite professor all semester, take her if you can!
